limitations: Original human Cargo logs identify package paths and successful completion but do not bind output executable bytes to all source/manifest/lock inputs.
Input hashes recorded now describe surviving scratch files; they cannot establish file contents at build time.
No rebuilt binary was compared with the measured executable. Historical configuration does not establish absence of inherited search/batch/token/thread tuning.
The retrospective comparison covers tracked snapshot files and declared overlays; subsequently added ignored integration tests and repository symlinks are outside this comparison.
